items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: he used to play several jobs with old man Dave Perkins

ctx.x: And Arthur would do it, never spit no food in his hand.

I know you've heard of it. Out on the lake shore there, he used to play several jobs with old man Dave Perkins. Oh yeah, it's a new band. Yeah, out on the lake. And I know he used to play a job with them and he would be standing up, just like to do
